run_ipc_weight_transfer: run IPC-based weight transfer from a training model to a vLLM inference engine using CUDA IPC handles

review_ipc_weight_transfer_engine: review the IPCWeightTransferEngine and IPCTrainerSendWeightsArgs APIs for broadcasting model weights
